targets.notes: Native launch and the read-only core are verified independently, but the system directory dialog through a real external-volume scan was not automated or manually completed in this run.
Representative token pairs pass their role thresholds and axe reports zero violations on landing and results states.
The actual Tauri macOS window was captured in isolation and inspected at full decoded resolution.
Code review found no network, move, rename, timestamp, or delete operation in the M0 command. UI text discloses possible filesystem-managed atime updates.
The Tauri webview implementation was exercised at the declared 1024x768 compact desktop boundary without lost evidence or overlap.
Semantic and axe checks passed, but VoiceOver reading order, live status announcements, and the native directory dialog were not manually evaluated.
In-product Lucide icons and the original brand mark render correctly, but the bundled app icon remains the Tauri scaffold asset and is not release-ready.
A keyboard-only Playwright test reaches the explicitly labelled synthetic scan and results; focus indicators and focus restoration are covered.
The corrected Tauri debug build command produces both the macOS application bundle and arm64 DMG.
The native development binary launches a titled 1280x820 macOS window and exits cleanly after inspection.
At 1280x820 the master-detail evidence layout, persistent synthetic-data notice, metrics, and inspector remain legible.
The native raster was decoded and inspected at original Retina resolution; browser captures were also reviewed at original size.
The direction contract maps signature evidence grammar, components, states, layout, accessibility, anti-goals, and repository ownership.

evidence.notes: Opaque representative colors use the same semantic roles as the repository DTCG token source.

evidence.command: pnpm tokens:check && pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm test:ui
evidence.notes: Five tests pass, including a mocked native scenario with two transient status-query failures that retains cancellation control, shows an uncertain-state warning, and recovers. Native cancellation semantics are covered separately by Rust tests.

evidence.command: cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/guiying-core/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/guiying-core/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path crates/guiying-core/Cargo.toml --all-features
evidence.notes: The core exposes no mutation API and fail-closed edge behavior is covered by the recorded Rust suite.

evidence.command: cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt && cargo test
evidence.notes: Seven task-runtime tests cover single-job exclusion, cooperative cancellation, terminal acknowledgement, owner cleanup, progress isolation and throttling, structured failure, and shared report storage.

evidence.command: Review src-tauri capabilities, Rust command calls, UI claims, synthetic fixtures, and captured window contents.
evidence.notes: The review corrected atime, partial-report, synthetic-data, metric, path, mount-session, and capability-language overclaims.
The native debug app and DMG bundle link the cancellable scan commands while retaining the no-write capability boundary.

evidence.tool: Tauri CLI and macOS CoreGraphics window listing
evidence.notes: The app process and titled native window were observed before a clean developer-session termination.

evidence.tool: macOS screencapture and full-size image inspection
evidence.command: Resolve the Guiying CoreGraphics window id, then screencapture -x -l WINDOW_ID evidence/native-landing-1280x820.png.
evidence.notes: Only the Guiying native window is present; the capture contains no other desktop windows or user media.
Synthetic data is persistently labelled; the 1024x768 master-detail view retains the safety footer and evidence rail.
The 1280x820 evidence workspace shows group ordering, synthetic notice, exact-byte proof, and weak time evidence without overlap.

evidence.command: Review design-direction.md against src/App.tsx, src/App.css, and the product safety documents.
evidence.notes: The system artifact documents the implemented visual thesis and the boundaries that remain intentionally locked.

limitations.impact: The evidence does not prove a complete macOS directory-dialog to real external-volume scan through the Tauri IPC bridge.
limitations.mitigation: Run the P0 external-volume matrix on disposable APFS and exFAT fixtures, exercise dialog selection and interruption cases, and attach the native run recording before changing this target to passed.

limitations.impact: Automated semantics cannot establish VoiceOver reading order, Chinese pronunciation, live progress behavior, or native dialog usability.
limitations.mitigation: Complete a VoiceOver-only walkthrough of idle, dialog return, scanning, partial report, result selection, issue disclosure, and error recovery on macOS.

limitations.impact: The debug application and DMG still use scaffold packaging icons and must not be treated as release-branded artifacts.
limitations.mitigation: Design the canonical application icon, export all macOS sizes, replace src-tauri/icons, and inspect the Dock, Finder, DMG, and 16px rendering before release.
